name: Indian Constitution & Polity
description: Historical evolution, Preamble, Fundamental Rights, DPSP, Federalism, Parliament, Judiciary, Executive.
subject: Polity

units.name: Constitutional Framework & Fundamental Principles
units.description: Making of Constitution, Preamble, Citizenship, FRs, DPSPs, Fundamental Duties.

topics.name: Evolution, Preamble & Citizenship
subtopics: Historical evolution of the Constitution (Regulating Act 1773 to Indian Independence Act 1947)
Constituent Assembly: Composition, working, Objective Resolution, Drafting Committee
Salient features of Indian Constitution: Blend of rigidity & flexibility, unitary tilt in federal setup
Preamble: Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic, Republic, Justice, Liberty, Equality, Fraternity
Amendability of Preamble and Kesavananda Bharati basic structure doctrine
Citizenship: Constitutional provisions (Articles 5-11), Citizenship Act 1955, CAA, NRC, OCI, PIO

topics.name: Fundamental Rights & Constitutional Remedies
subtopics: Concept of State under Article 12 and Judicial Review under Article 13
Right to Equality (Articles 14 to 18): Rule of law, non-arbitrariness, affirmative action & reservation debate
Right to Freedom (Articles 19 to 22): Freedom of speech, reasonable restrictions, right to privacy (Puttaswamy)
Protection in respect of conviction (Article 20) and Protection of life & personal liberty (Article 21, Due Process)
Right against Exploitation (Articles 23 and 24): Prohibition of trafficking, forced labour, child labour
Right to Freedom of Religion (Articles 25 to 28): Essential Religious Practices doctrine, Uniform Civil Code debate
Cultural and Educational Rights (Articles 29 and 30): Minority rights protection
Right to Constitutional Remedies (Article 32 & 226): Writs (Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Quo-Warranto, Certiorari)
Armed Forces and Fundamental Rights (Article 33), Martial Law (Article 34)

topics.name: DPSP, Fundamental Duties & Basic Structure
subtopics: Directive Principles of State Policy (Articles 36 to 51): Socialistic, Gandhian, Liberal-intellectual principles
Implementation of DPSPs, conflict between Fundamental Rights and DPSPs (Champakam Dorairajan to Minerva Mills)
Fundamental Duties (Article 51A): Swaran Singh Committee, 42nd & 86th Amendments, legal enforceability
Basic Structure Doctrine: Evolution from Shankari Prasad, Golaknath to Kesavananda Bharati and its elements

units.name: Federal Structure & Centre-State Relations
units.description: Legislative, administrative, financial relations, Governor's role, Article 356, Inter-state councils.

topics.name: Centre-State Relations & Federal Issues
subtopics: Legislative Relations: Seventh Schedule (Union, State, Concurrent Lists), Residuary powers, Parliamentary supremacy
Administrative Relations: Centre's directions to States, All India Services (AIS), deployment of central armed forces
Financial Relations: Distribution of tax revenues, GST Council, Finance Commission recommendations, cess and surcharges
Role of the Governor: Discretionary powers, reservation of bills for President (Article 200/201), floor test guidelines
Emergency Provisions: National Emergency (Article 352), President's Rule (Article 356, S.R. Bommai guidelines), Financial Emergency
Inter-State Mechanisms: Inter-State Council (Article 263), Zonal Councils, Inter-State River Water Disputes Act

units.name: Union & State Executive and Legislature
units.description: President, Prime Minister, Council of Ministers, Parliament workings, State Legislatures.

topics.name: The Executive: President, PM & Cabinet
subtopics: President of India: Election (proportional representation), powers (Executive, Legislative, Financial, Pardoning Art 72), Impeachment
Vice President: Election, functions, ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha
Prime Minister and Council of Ministers: Appointment, Collective responsibility (Article 75), Cabinet system, PMO
Governor and Chief Minister: Comparative powers with President and PM, coalition politics dynamics
Attorney General of India (Article 76) and Advocate General for the State

topics.name: Parliament & State Legislatures Functioning
subtopics: Composition of Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha, delimitation commission
Presiding Officers: Speaker, Deputy Speaker, Chairman, powers and neutrality
Sessions of Parliament, Question Hour, Zero Hour, Calling Attention, Adjournment motions, No-Confidence motion
Legislative Procedure: Ordinary bills, Money bills (Article 110), Financial bills, Joint sitting (Article 108)
Parliamentary Privileges (Article 105) and issues of codification
Parliamentary Committees: Standing committees, PAC, Estimates Committee, Committee on Public Undertakings
Decline of Parliamentary productivity, ordinance raj (Article 123/213), Anti-Defection Law (Tenth Schedule)

units.name: Judiciary & Constitutional/Statutory Bodies
units.description: Supreme Court, High Courts, Collegium, Judicial Activism, ECI, UPSC, CAG, NITI Aayog.

topics.name: The Judiciary: Integrated & Independent System
subtopics: Supreme Court: Composition, appointment of judges, Collegium system vs NJAC, independence safeguards
Jurisdiction of Supreme Court: Original, Appellate, Advisory (Article 143), Writ jurisdiction, Curative petition
High Courts and Subordinate Judiciary: Powers, supervision, pendency of cases, All India Judicial Service (AIJS) proposal
Judicial Review, Judicial Activism vs Judicial Overreach, Public Interest Litigation (PIL)
Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR): Lok Adalats, Gram Nyayalayas, Arbitration and Conciliation, Tribunals (Part XIV-A)

topics.name: Constitutional & Statutory Bodies
subtopics: Election Commission of India (Article 324): Appointment, powers, electoral reforms, model code of conduct
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (Articles 315-323)
Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG, Article 148): Public purse guardian, audit reports
Finance Commission (Article 280): Terms of reference, devolution criteria
National Commissions: NCSC, NCST, NCBC, National Commission for Minorities, NCW, NCPCR
Statutory & Regulatory Bodies: NHRC, CIC, CVC, Lokpal and Lokayuktas, CBI, SEBI, TRAI, CCI, NGT, NITI Aayog

topics.name: Local Self-Government: Panchayats & Municipalities
subtopics: 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act: 3-tier Panchayati Raj, Gram Sabha, reservation, Eleventh Schedule
74th Constitutional Amendment Act: Municipal corporations, municipalities, Nagar Panchayats, Twelfth Schedule
PESA Act 1996: Extension to Scheduled Areas, empowerment of tribal Gram Sabhas
Challenges of 3Fs: Funds, Functions, Functionaries, State Finance Commissions, municipal bonds

name: Governance & Public Policy
description: Citizen centric governance, transparency, RTI, citizen charters, e-governance, civil services.
subject: Governance

units.name: Transparency, Accountability & Citizen Participation
units.description: RTI Act, Citizen Charters, Social Audits, Whistleblower protection, Sevottam model.

topics.name: RTI, Citizen Charters & Social Audits
subtopics: Right to Information (RTI) Act 2005: Provisions, exemptions (Section 8), CIC powers, challenges, digital challenges
Citizen's Charters: Objectives, components, implementation hurdles, Sevottam model of public service delivery
Social Audit: Concepts, institutionalization (MGNREGA model), community empowerment
Ombudsman mechanisms: Lokpal and Lokayuktas Act, grievance redressal portals (CPGRAMS)
Whistleblower Protection Act and protection of witnesses

topics.name: e-Governance & Digital Public Infrastructure
subtopics: e-Governance: Applications, models (G2C, G2B, G2G, G2E), success stories (DigiLocker, UMANG, UPI, GeM)
Digital Public Infrastructure (India Stack): Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker, Account Aggregator, ONDC
Challenges in e-Governance: Digital divide, data privacy, cybersecurity, connectivity gaps
Role of Civil Services in a Democracy: Steel frame of India, bureaucratic neutrality vs commitment, Mission Karmayogi, lateral entry debate

name: Social Justice & Welfare Schemes
description: Welfare of vulnerable sections (SC, ST, OBC, Women, Children, Minorities, PwD), Health, Education, Poverty.
subject: Social Justice

units.name: Welfare Schemes & Vulnerable Sections
units.description: Constitutional protections, institutional mechanisms, flagship welfare schemes.

topics.name: Empowerment of Vulnerable Sections
subtopics: Constitutional and statutory protections for SCs, STs (Prevention of Atrocities Act, Forest Rights Act)
OBC reservation, Creamy layer criteria, Rohini Commission on sub-categorization of OBCs
Welfare of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD Act 2016, Accessible India Campaign)
Senior Citizens welfare, Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act
Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, National Portal for Transgenders
Manual scavenging eradication: Prohibition of Employment as Manual Scavengers Act, NAMASTE scheme

topics.name: Health, Education, Human Capital & Hunger
subtopics: Health Sector: National Health Policy 2017, Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY, HWCs/Arogya Mandirs), primary healthcare infrastructure
Disease burden: Non-communicable diseases, infectious diseases, Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)
Education Sector: National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, Right to Education (RTE) Act, Samagra Shiksha, NIPUN Bharat
Higher education reforms, Academic Bank of Credits, foreign universities entry
Issues relating to Poverty & Hunger: Global Hunger Index, NFHS-5 findings, POSHAN Abhiyaan, NFSA 2013, PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana

name: International Relations
description: India's foreign policy, neighbourhood relations, major powers, groupings (QUAD, BRICS, SCO), UN bodies.
subject: International Relations

units.name: Foreign Policy Principles & India's Neighbourhood
units.description: Panchsheel, Non-Alignment, Neighbourhood First, Act East, Bilateral relations.

topics.name: India & Immediate Neighbours
subtopics: Determinants and evolution of Indian Foreign Policy: Non-Alignment to Strategic Autonomy and Multi-Alignment
Neighbourhood First Policy and Gujral Doctrine
India-Nepal: 1950 Treaty, border disputes (Kalapani, Lipulekh), hydro-power cooperation, China factor
India-Bhutan: Special relationship, security pact, hydro-electric projects, Doklam tri-junction
India-Bangladesh: Land Boundary Agreement (LBA), Teesta dispute, transit connectivity, trade and security cooperation
India-Sri Lanka: Fishermen issues, 13th Amendment, Colombo Port terminal, economic assistance
India-Maldives: Strategic importance, Muizzu administration, Indian ocean security, infrastructure lines of credit
India-Pakistan: Kashmir dispute, cross-border terrorism, Indus Waters Treaty 1960, trade suspension
India-Afghanistan: Chabahar port connectivity, humanitarian assistance, engagement with Taliban

units.name: Major Powers, Regional Blocs & Global Institutions
units.description: USA, Russia, China, EU, QUAD, BRICS, SCO, ASEAN, WTO, UN reforms.

topics.name: Major Powers Bilateral Relations
subtopics: India-USA: Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership, 2+2 dialogue, iCET, Defense pacts (LEMOA, COMCASA, BECA)
India-Russia: Special and Privileged Strategic Partnership, military-technical ties (S-400), energy trade, Ukraine fallout
India-China: LAC standoffs (Galwan, Depsang), boundary negotiation mechanisms, trade deficit, Belt & Road Initiative (BRI) concerns
India-Japan: Special Strategic and Global Partnership, bullet train project, Asia-Africa Growth Corridor
India-West Asia: Look West Policy, Israel, Saudi Arabia, UAE (CEPA), I2U2 minilateral group, IMEC corridor
India-Africa: Historical links, African Union entry into G20, development cooperation, line of credit

topics.name: Regional Groupings & Global Governance
subtopics: Indo-Pacific & QUAD: Maritime domain awareness, supply chain resilience, open and inclusive Indo-Pacific
BRICS: Expansion (BRICS+), de-dollarization debate, New Development Bank (NDB)
Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO): Security, counter-terrorism (RATS), connectivity
BIMSTEC vs SAARC: Sub-regional integration, Bay of Bengal master plan
ASEAN: Act East Policy, ASEAN centrality, Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) issues
United Nations & UNSC Reforms: India's bid for permanent membership (G4 nations), UN peacekeeping contribution
Bretton Woods Institutions (IMF, World Bank, WTO): Dispute Settlement Mechanism paralysis, WTO Appellate body, trade disputes
